mainEntity.name: How much is a taxi from Vodice to Murter?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fixed €50 per car for up to 4 passengers, one way, luggage included. A return trip is €100.

mainEntity.name: Is the price per person or per vehicle?

acceptedAnswer.text: The price is per vehicle, not per person. It covers up to 4 passengers and luggage at no extra cost, with a small additional fee for 5 or 6 passengers.
At your exact address in Vodice, whether a home, hotel or apartment. Send the address when you book and Bernard will confirm the meeting point.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Advance booking is recommended to guarantee availability, especially during peak summer season. For a last-minute ride, call or WhatsApp Bernard directly.
